'''Scott Watson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 42nd at [[2000 Tatooine Regionals]] on 8 July 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]], according to Enrique Huerta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1001">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-13-tatooine-regional-07-08-00d1001/ tatooine-regional-07-08-00], DeckTech (Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta, 13 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-13-tatooine-regional-07-08-00d1001/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
